about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Your trusted partner for car rentals
about.storyBody: Founded in 2020, RentCar has been dedicated to providing exceptional car rental experiences. We understand that every journey is unique, and we're committed to offering a diverse fleet of vehicles to match your specific needs.
about.missionBody: To make car rentals simple, affordable, and accessible for everyone. We believe in transparent pricing, quality vehicles, and outstanding customer service.
about.feature1Body: From economy to luxury, electric to SUV - we have the perfect car for every occasion.
about.feature2Body: No hidden fees. What you see is what you pay. Simple, clear, and honest.
about.feature3Body: Our customer support team is always ready to assist you, anytime, anywhere.

help.title: Help & Support
help.heading: How can we help you?
help.subtitle: Find answers to common questions below
help.stillNeedHelpBody: Can't find what you're looking for? Our support team is here to help.

booking.question: How do I book a car?
booking.answer: Browse our available cars, select the one you like, choose your dates and location, and complete the checkout process. You'll receive a confirmation email immediately.

documents.question: What documents do I need?
documents.answer: You'll need a valid driver's license, a credit card in your name, and proof of insurance. International customers may also need a passport.

modify.question: Can I modify or cancel my booking?
modify.answer: Yes! You can modify or cancel your booking up to 24 hours before pickup through your account dashboard. Cancellation fees may apply depending on timing.

pricing.question: What's included in the rental price?
pricing.answer: Our prices include basic insurance, unlimited mileage, and 24/7 roadside assistance. Additional features like GPS or child seats can be added for a fee.

late.question: What if I return the car late?
late.answer: Late returns are charged hourly at 1/4 of the daily rate. If you're more than 2 hours late, you'll be charged for a full additional day.

longTerm.question: Do you offer long-term rentals?
longTerm.answer: Yes! We offer discounted rates for rentals longer than 7 days. Contact our support team for custom long-term rental packages.

agb.title: Terms & Conditions
agb.intro: The following Terms & Conditions (T&C) govern the use of our car rental service.

scope.title: Scope
scope.content1: These T&C apply to all rental contracts between RentCar GmbH (hereinafter "Lessor") and the customer (hereinafter "Lessee").
scope.content2: Deviating, conflicting or supplementary T&C of the Lessee do not become part of the contract.

contract.title: Contract Conclusion
contract.intro: The rental contract is concluded through the following steps:

steps.booking: Online booking of the rental car by the Lessee
steps.confirmation: Confirmation of the booking by the Lessor
steps.contract: Contract is concluded upon handover of the vehicle

prices.title: Prices and Payment Terms
prices.content1: All prices are stated in Euros including statutory VAT. The prices include basic insurance and unlimited mileage.
prices.content2: Additional services (e.g. GPS, child seat, additional driver) are to be paid separately.

payment.title: Payment
payment.content1: Payment can be made by credit card, bank transfer or other offered payment methods.
payment.content2: When paying by bank transfer, the rental fee must be settled before vehicle pickup.

pickup.title: Vehicle Pickup
pickup.content1: The Lessee is obliged to pick up the vehicle at the agreed time and location. If the vehicle is not picked up, the right to the vehicle expires.
pickup.content2: A valid driver's license, ID card or passport and a credit card must be presented upon pickup.

return.title: Vehicle Return
return.content1: The vehicle must be returned at the agreed time and location. Additional fees will be charged for late returns.
return.content2: The vehicle must be returned with the same fuel level as at pickup.

liability.title: Liability
liability.content1: The Lessor is not liable for damages resulting from improper use of the vehicle.
liability.content2: The Lessee is liable for all damages to the vehicle during the rental period, unless they were caused by fault of the Lessor.

cancellation.title: Cancellation
cancellation.content1: Cancellations can be made free of charge up to 24 hours before pickup. Late cancellations may incur cancellation fees.
cancellation.content2: Details on the right of withdrawal can be found in our Cancellation Policy.

applicableLaw.title: Applicable Law
applicableLaw.content: The law of the Federal Republic of Germany applies, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods.

widerruf.title: Cancellation Policy
widerruf.intro: Consumers have the right to cancel this contract within fourteen days without giving any reason.

right.title: Right of Withdrawal
right.content1: You have the right to cancel this contract within 14 days without giving any reason.
right.content2: The withdrawal period is 14 days from the day of the contract conclusion.

period.title: Withdrawal Period
period.content1: To exercise your right of withdrawal, you must inform us (RentCar GmbH, Musterstraße 123, 10115 Berlin, Germany, Email: info@rentcar.de) by means of a clear statement of your decision to withdraw from this contract.
period.content2: To meet the withdrawal deadline, it is sufficient for you to send your communication concerning your exercise of the right of withdrawal before the withdrawal period has expired.

procedure.title: Withdrawal Procedure
procedure.intro: To exercise the right of withdrawal, please contact us at:

consequences.title: Consequences of Withdrawal
consequences.content1: If you withdraw from this contract, we shall reimburse to you all payments received from you, including the costs of delivery (with the exception of the supplementary costs resulting from the choice of a type of delivery other than the least expensive type of standard delivery offered by us), without undue delay and in any event not later than 14 days from the day on which we are informed about your decision to withdraw from this contract.
consequences.content2: We may withhold reimbursement until we have received the goods back or you have supplied evidence of having sent back the goods, whichever is the earliest.

exceptions.title: Exclusion of Right of Withdrawal
exceptions.intro: The right of withdrawal does not exist for:

items.perishable: Contracts for the supply of goods which are not pre-manufactured and for the manufacture of which an individual selection or determination by the consumer is decisive
items.custom: Contracts for the supply of goods which are liable to deteriorate or expire rapidly
items.urgent: Contracts for the supply of sealed goods which are not suitable for return due to health protection or hygiene reasons, if their seal has been removed after delivery
items.sealed: Contracts which provide for immediate performance and where the trader has confirmed that he has begun the performance after the consumer has exercised his right of withdrawal
